ei.title: 3번: CBT: Changing Thoughts to Change Behavior
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Unrealistic thinking causes people to behave in negative ways. Now, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is being used to end this cycle. It helps people change the way they think, which leads to positive behavior. Some people, for example, are afraid of leaving their homes. They think it will cause a fatal panic attack. CBT helps them view panic attacks more positively — they're unpleasant, but they're not deadly. This kind of mental shift can improve behavior in terms of people being more willing to confront situations that cause them fear. Some patients do this through a CBT technique called exposure therapy. They are being taught to face their fears directly. A person afraid to go outside might be taken to a nearby shop. The next step could be visiting a busy supermarket. Gradually, these experiences should decrease the intensity of the person's fear.

questions.passage: Unrealistic thinking causes people to behave in (A)[negative / positive] ways. Now, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is being used to end this cycle. It helps people change the way they think, which leads to positive behavior. Some people, for example, are afraid of leaving their homes. They think it will cause a (B)[fatal / minor] panic attack. CBT helps them view panic attacks more positively — they're unpleasant, but they're not deadly. This kind of mental shift can improve behavior in terms of people being more willing to (C)[confront / avoid] situations that cause them fear. Some patients do this through a CBT technique called exposure therapy. They are being taught to face their fears directly. A person afraid to go outside might be taken to a nearby shop. The next step could be visiting a busy supermarket. Gradually, these experiences should decrease the intensity of the person's fear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① positive — fatal — confront: (A) positive(긍정적인)는 negative(부정적인)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ② negative — fatal — confront: 원문 일치. 비현실적 사고가 부정적(negative) 행동을 유발, 치명적(fatal) 공황발작, 두려운 상황에 직면(confront)
❌ ③ negative — minor — confront: (B) minor(사소한)는 fatal(치명적인)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ negative — fatal — avoid: (C) avoid(피하다)는 confront(직면하다)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: unrealistic thinking → negative behavior / fatal panic attack / confront situations

questions.passage: Unrealistic thinking causes people to behave in negative ways. Now, (A)[cognitive / physical] behavioral therapy (CBT) is being used to end this cycle. It helps people change the way they think, which leads to positive behavior. Some people, for example, are afraid of leaving their homes. They think it will cause a fatal panic attack. CBT helps them view panic attacks more positively — they're unpleasant, but they're not deadly. This kind of mental shift can improve behavior in terms of people being more willing to confront situations that cause them fear. Some patients do this through a CBT technique called (B)[exposure / avoidance] therapy. They are being taught to face their fears directly. A person afraid to go outside might be taken to a nearby shop. The next step could be visiting a busy supermarket. Gradually, these experiences should (C)[decrease / increase] the intensity of the person's fear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① cognitive — avoidance — decrease: (B) avoidance(회피)는 exposure(노출)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② physical — exposure — decrease: (A) physical(신체적인)은 cognitive(인지적인)와 의미 불일치
❌ ③ cognitive — exposure — increase: (C) increase(증가시키다)는 decrease(감소시키다)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ④ cognitive — exposure — decrease: 원문 일치. 인지(cognitive) 행동 치료, 노출(exposure) 치료, 두려움의 강도를 감소시킴(decrease)
det.tip: cognitive behavioral therapy / exposure therapy / decrease the intensity

questions.passage: Unrealistic thinking causes people to behave in negative ways. Now, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is being used to end this cycle. It helps people change the way they think, which leads to positive behavior. Some people, for example, are afraid of leaving their homes. They think it will cause a fatal panic attack. CBT helps them view panic attacks more positively — they're (A)[unpleasant / pleasant], but they're not deadly. This kind of mental shift can improve behavior in terms of people being more (B)[willing / reluctant] to confront situations that cause them fear. Some patients do this through a CBT technique called exposure therapy. They are being taught to face their fears directly. A person afraid to go outside might be taken to a nearby shop. The next step could be visiting a busy supermarket. Gradually, these experiences should decrease the (C)[intensity / frequency] of the person's fear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① pleasant — willing — intensity: (A) pleasant(유쾌한)는 unpleasant(불쾌한)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② unpleasant — reluctant — intensity: (B) reluctant(꺼리는)는 willing(기꺼이 하는)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ③ unpleasant — willing — intensity: 원문 일치. 공황발작은 불쾌하지만(unpleasant) 치명적이지 않음, 기꺼이(willing) 직면, 두려움의 강도(intensity) 감소
❌ ④ unpleasant — willing — frequency: (C) frequency(빈도)는 intensity(강도)와 다른 개념으로 부적절
det.tip: they're unpleasant, but they're not deadly / more willing to confront / the intensity of the person's fear

questions.passage: Unrealistic thinking causes people to ①<u>behave</u> in negative ways. Now, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is being used to end this cycle. It helps people change the way they think, which leads to ②<u>negative</u> behavior. Some people, for example, are afraid of leaving their homes. They think it will cause a fatal panic attack. CBT helps them view panic attacks more positively — they're unpleasant, but they're not deadly. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: CBT는 긍정적(positive) 행동으로 이끄는데, negative(부정적인)로 바꾸면 문맥 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① behave — 원문 일치. 사람들이 부정적으로 '행동하다'라는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② negative — 원문은 positive(긍정적인). CBT가 사고를 바꿔 긍정적 행동으로 이끈다는 문맥에서 negative(부정적인)는 부적절
❌ ③ shift — 원문 일치. 정신적 전환이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ decrease — 원문 일치. 두려움의 강도를 줄인다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: which leads to positive behavior — CBT가 긍정적 행동으로 이끈다. negative로 바꾸면 의미 반전

det.korean: 경험이 두려움의 강도를 '감소시킨다(decrease)'가 맞는데 increase(증가시키다)는 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① cycle — 원문 일치. 비현실적 사고의 악순환이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② afraid — 원문 일치. 집 밖으로 나가는 것을 두려워한다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ③ directly — 원문 일치. 두려움에 직접 맞서다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ increase — 원문은 decrease(감소시키다). 경험이 두려움의 강도를 점차 줄인다는 맥락에서 increase(증가시키다)는 부적절
det.tip: Gradually, these experiences should decrease the intensity — decrease(감소) → increase(증가)로 바꾸면 CBT 목적에 반함

This kind of mental shift can improve behavior in terms of people being more ①<u>reluctant</u> to confront situations that cause them fear. Some patients do this through a CBT technique called exposure therapy. They are being taught to face their fears directly. A person afraid to go outside might be taken to a ④<u>nearby</u> shop. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: CBT로 사람들이 더 '기꺼이(willing)' 직면하게 되는데 reluctant(꺼리는)는 문맥에 반함.
det.analysis:
✅ ① reluctant — 원문은 willing(기꺼이 하는). CBT가 사람들이 두려운 상황에 더 기꺼이 직면하게 한다는 맥락에서 reluctant(꺼리는)는 부적절
❌ ② unrealistic — 원문 일치. 비현실적 사고가 원인이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ③ unpleasant — 원문 일치. 공황발작이 불쾌하다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ nearby — 원문 일치. 가까운 가게라는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: more willing to confront situations — willing(기꺼이) → reluctant(꺼리는)로 바꾸면 CBT의 효과와 모순

det.analysis:
❌ ① improve: 개선하다 → 앞 문장에 이미 나온 단어. 상황에 기꺼이 improve는 어색
✅ ② confront: 직면하다 → CBT의 정신적 전환으로 두려운 상황에 기꺼이 맞서게 됨
❌ ③ cycle: 순환 → 명사로 이 맥락에서 동사로 쓰기 부적절
❌ ④ shift: 전환 → 정신적 전환은 이미 앞에 나옴. 상황에 shift는 어색
det.tip: more willing to confront situations that cause them fear — confront = 직면하다, 맞서다

det.analysis:

❌ ③ behavioral: 행동의 → CBT의 구성 요소이지 특정 기법 이름이 아님
❌ ④ panic: 공황 → 증상의 이름이지 치료 기법이 아님
det.tip: exposure therapy = 노출 치료. 두려움의 대상에 단계적으로 노출시키는 CBT 기법

det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 behave와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① recover: 회복하다 → 행동하다와 의미 다름
❌ ② struggle: 고군분투하다 → 행동하다와 의미 차이
✅ ③ act: 행동하다 → behave의 동의어
❌ ④ believe: 믿다 → 인지적 행위로 행동과 다름
det.tip: behave = act = 행동하다. 사람들이 부정적으로 행동한다는 맥락

det.korean: deadly = 치명적인, 생명을 위협하는. 동의어: lethal
det.analysis:
❌ ① harmful: 해로운 → 정도가 약함. deadly는 생명을 위협하는 수준
❌ ② painful: 고통스러운 → 고통이지 치명적이라는 의미가 아님
❌ ③ severe: 심한 → 정도를 나타내지만 치명적이라는 의미는 아님
✅ ④ lethal: 치명적인 → deadly와 동의어. 생명을 앗아갈 수 있는
det.tip: deadly = lethal = 치명적인. they're not deadly = 공황발작은 치명적이지 않다

❌ ③ monitor: 감시하다 → 관찰하는 것이지 개선하는 것이 아님
❌ ④ predict: 예측하다 → 미래를 내다보는 것이지 개선하는 것이 아님
det.tip: improve = enhance = 개선하다. 정신적 전환이 행동을 개선할 수 있다는 맥락

det.analysis:

❌ ② cautious: 조심스러운 → afraid와 관련되지만 반대가 아님
❌ ③ nervous: 긴장한 → afraid와 유사한 의미

questions.passage:

✅ ① 직면하다 — 향하다: (A) face one's fears = 두려움에 직면하다, (B) face the park = 공원을 향하다
❌ ② 피하다 — 직면하다: (A) face는 직면하다이지 피하다가 아님. 순서 반전
❌ ③ 향하다 — 피하다: (A)는 향하다가 아닌 직면하다, (B)는 피하다가 아님
❌ ④ 직면하다 — 피하다: (B) face는 향하다이지 피하다가 아님
det.tip: face (1) 직면하다: face one's fears = 두려움에 맞서다 (2) 향하다: The building faces ~ = 건물이 ~을 향하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a treatment intended to improve a medical or psychological condition"

det.korean: 의학적/심리적 상태를 개선하기 위한 치료 = therapy
det.analysis:
❌ ① symptom: 증상 → 질병의 징후이지 치료법이 아님
✅ ② therapy: 치료 → 의학적/심리적 상태 개선을 위한 치료법으로 정의와 일치
❌ ③ diagnosis: 진단 → 질병을 판별하는 것이지 개선을 위한 치료가 아님
❌ ④ prescription: 처방 → 약물 지시이지 치료법 전체를 의미하지 않음
det.tip: therapy = 치료. cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) = 인지 행동 치료

questions.passage: Now, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is being __________ (use) to end this cycle. It helps people change the way they think, which leads to positive behavior.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 수동 진행형: is being used = 사용되고 있다 → used
det.analysis: is being + 과거분사 = 수동 진행형. use → used(과거분사). 'CBT is being used to end this cycle' = CBT가 이 악순환을 끝내기 위해 사용되고 있다
det.tip: 수동 진행형: be being + p.p. use-used-used. 규칙 변화 동사

questions.passage: A person afraid to go outside might be __________ (take) to a nearby shop. The next step could be visiting a busy supermarket.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 수동태: might be taken = 데려가질 수 있다 → taken
det.analysis: 조동사 might + be + 과거분사 = 수동태. take → taken(과거분사). 'might be taken to a nearby shop' = 가까운 가게에 데려가질 수 있다
det.tip: might be + p.p. = 수동태. take-took-taken. 불규칙 변화 동사

questions.passage: Unrealistic thinking causes people to behave in negative ways. Now, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is being used to __________. It helps people change the way they think, which leads to positive behavior. Some people, for example, are afraid of leaving their homes. They think it will cause a fatal panic attack. CBT helps them view panic attacks more positively — they're unpleasant, but they're not deadly. This kind of mental shift can improve behavior in terms of people being more willing to confront situations that cause them fear. Some patients do this through a CBT technique called exposure therapy. They are being taught to face their fears directly. A person afraid to go outside might be taken to a nearby shop. The next step could be visiting a busy supermarket. Gradually, these experiences should decrease the intensity of the person's fear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: CBT가 이 악순환을 '끝내기 위해' 사용되고 있다
det.analysis:
❌ ① cause a fatal panic attack: 치명적 공황발작을 유발하다 → CBT의 목적에 반함
❌ ② face their fears directly: 두려움에 직접 맞서다 → 노출 치료의 세부 방법이지 CBT의 전체 목적이 아님
✅ ③ end this cycle: 이 악순환을 끝내다 → 비현실적 사고가 부정적 행동을 유발하는 순환을 CBT로 끝낸다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ visit a busy supermarket: 바쁜 슈퍼마켓을 방문하다 → 노출 치료의 구체적 단계이지 CBT의 목적이 아님
det.tip: Now, CBT is being used to end this cycle — CBT의 목적은 비현실적 사고의 악순환을 끝내는 것

questions.passage: Unrealistic thinking causes people to behave in negative ways. Now, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is being used to end this cycle. It helps people __________, which leads to positive behavior. Some people, for example, are afraid of leaving their homes. They think it will cause a fatal panic attack. CBT helps them view panic attacks more positively — they're unpleasant, but they're not deadly. This kind of mental shift can improve behavior in terms of people being more willing to confront situations that cause them fear. Some patients do this through a CBT technique called exposure therapy. They are being taught to face their fears directly. A person afraid to go outside might be taken to a nearby shop. The next step could be visiting a busy supermarket. Gradually, these experiences should decrease the intensity of the person's fear.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① view panic attacks more positively: 공황발작을 더 긍정적으로 보다 → CBT의 세부 효과이지 '돕는' 핵심 내용이 아님
❌ ② end this cycle of fear: 두려움의 악순환을 끝내다 → CBT의 목적이지 빈칸 앞 helps의 직접 목적어로 부적절
✅ ③ change the way they think: 생각하는 방식을 바꾸다 → CBT의 핵심 원리. 사고 방식 변화 → 긍정적 행동으로 이어짐
❌ ④ confront situations that cause them fear: 두려운 상황에 직면하다 → 노출 치료의 결과이지 CBT의 직접적 도움 내용이 아님
det.tip: It helps people change the way they think, which leads to positive behavior — 사고 변화가 행동 변화로 이어짐

ch: confront situations that cause them fear
